Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that uses an agent-based model to simulate land transactions between farmers and nature-conservation organizations under global change scenarios. While it includes spatially explicit modeling of land acquisitions for the National Ecological Network (NEN) in a case study area (Baakse Beek, ~300 km² in Gelderland province), the study is explicitly regional/local in scale—not national. The methodology, results, and discussion all focus on this sub-national case. Although the broader policy context is national (the NEN), the actual modeling and projections are not implemented at the national scale. Additionally, the primary objective is not general LULC prediction but rather assessing feasibility of ecological network implementation under socio-ecological constraints. The study does not produce mapped national LULC projections, nor does it meet the core inclusion criterion of "explicit national-scale spatial implementation." It also lacks quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC change (e.g., validation against observed data, confusion matrices), focusing instead on simulated transaction dynamics and budget outcomes.)
